The driving route we took through the country using Alex's road maps. Maybe a section of scary routes at the end with elevation. [@cr-route]{pan-to="0%,-13%" scale-by="1"}

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="260%,-177%" scale-by="10"}

June 17th: Arrival in Iceland

1. Landed at the Keflavík International Airport
2. Drove to Reykjavik:
    - Walked around the city
    - It was the National Day of Iceland!

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="95%,-90%" scale-by="6"}

June 18th: Landmarks in southwest Iceland

3. Thingvellir is the site of Iceland's parliament from the 10th the 18th century
4. Geysir, a.k.a. The *Great Geysir*, is a hot spring and geothermal area
5. Gullfoss, a.k.a. *Golden Falls*, is a huge two-tiered waterfall

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="370%,-260%" scale-by="16"}

June 19th: Back to Reykjavik

6. More activities in the capital:
    - National Museum of Iceland
    - Grotta lighthouse
    - Nautholsvik beach
    - Some interesting stores we missed on day 1

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="50%,-20%" scale-by="2.2"}

June 20th: First day towards the Westfjords

7. Barnafoss and Hraunfossar waterfalls
8. Tour of the Víðgelmir lava tube cave
9. Arrival at Gil Guesthouse for the night

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="115%,30%" scale-by="3.5"}

June 21st: Beaches and Birds

10. Rauðisandur, the red sand beaches
11. Látrabjarg, the westernmost point in Iceland
12. Arrival at Harbour Inn Guesthouse for the night

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="175%,82%" scale-by="5"}

June 22nd: A day in Ísafjörður

13. Dynjandi waterfall
14. Arrival in Ísafjörður, the largest settlement of the Westfjords (pop. 2744)
    - Bike tour around the avalanche walls of Ísafjörður
15. Arrival at Einarshús Guesthouse for the night

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="85%,35%" scale-by="3"}

June 23th: Along the eastern Westfjords

16. Whale-watching in Ísafjarðardjúp and Jökulfirðir
17. Sheep farming Museum south of Holmavik
18. Museum of Witchcraft and Sorcery in Holmavik
19. Arrival at Dalahótel for the night, which included a natural hot spring

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="45%,-25%" scale-by="2"}

June 24th: Happy birthday, Alex! A special day to celebrate

20. Horse riding at Dalahestar
21. Drive back down past Reykjavik to some geothermal sites around the Reykjanes
22. Arrival at Northern Light Inn for a birthday dinner and an evening at the Blue Lagoon spa

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="230%,-170%" scale-by="9"}

June 25th: More of the Reykjanes

23. Very long hike along Fagradalsfjall volcano
24. Visit to the Bridge Between Continents, which spans a fissure between the Eurasian and North American tectonic plates
25. Drive back to Reykjavik for an evening at the Sky Lagoon spa

:::

::: {focus-on="cr-route" pan-to="0%,-13%" scale-by="1"}

June 26th: Goodbye Iceland!

26. Drive back to Keflavík International Airport to catch our early flight home

That's all!

:::
